newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Computerised dealing takes Tunis bourse index down.
newsitem.headline: Computerised dealing takes Tunis bourse index down.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed down by 1.23 percent driven by Banque de l'Habitat fall by 40 percent, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 533.75 from 540.38 on Friday.
Volume was 2.04 million dinars against 268,910 dinars. About half of the volume traded was in over-the-counter exchanges.

"Dealing on Banque de l'Habitat through the computerised system since last week made its price adjusts to the market and reflect its true value. It finally dropped by 15.53 dinars to 23.2 dinars," a broker said.
Since last October, the Tunis bourse has been putting by stages the listed firms on the computerised dealing.
So far, 23 from 31 listed companies are traded through the computerised system. Eight banks are still traded on the blackboard and are expected to join the others over the next few weeks.
Banque du Sud was up 0.5 dinar to 26.57 dinars. BTEI was down 0.16 dinar to 21.82 dinars. ($= one dinar)
